title: OL-20261115-23: ACCOUNT-SPLIT-1: cutover to the ultrastable Cloudflare account waits on the GitHub credential
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** GitHub credential present on the target tick
**Done check:** grep:deploy/transfer/plan.json::2-copy done, 3-verify done
**Status:** open

Code and org data are live on the ultrastable account (workers.dev), crons still on quniverse. Cutover needs the GitHub App credential on the target tick; the in-Cloudflare re-seal was refused by the session permission check and reverted.
